cases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},{'edges':{}},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'bad','attempts':0},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'good','attempts':True},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'good','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})]
